description: Source file defining the Opencart\Admin\Model\Tool\Upload class which manages file upload operations such as adding, deleting, and retrieving uploads in the OpenCart admin module.

classes.name: Upload
classes.description: Model class for managing upload records in the database, providing methods to add, delete, and retrieve upload information.

methods.name: addUpload
methods.description: Creates a new upload record with a specified name and filename, generates a unique code, saves it to the database, and returns the code.

methods.name: deleteUpload
methods.description: Deletes an upload record from the database based on the upload ID.

methods.name: getUpload
methods.description: Retrieves a specific upload record from the database by upload ID.

methods.name: getUploadByCode
methods.description: Retrieves an upload record based on its unique code.

methods.name: getUploads
methods.description: Returns a list of upload records, optionally filtered and sorted according to provided criteria.

methods.name: getTotalUploads
methods.description: Returns the total count of upload records matching optional filter criteria.
